reviews.title: Inappropriate ad pop ups
reviews.text: I work with children and use this app on company devices to help kiddos. Unfortunately, explicit sexual content has popped up as an ad. Again I use a company device and WiFi that have restrictions in place. This is very concerning especially since this is an app with visuals for children!

reviews.title: Great little visual timer
reviews.text:
Great little visual timer. I use it with my grandkids and students to keep track of time. The only problem with this timer is that they sometimes get so interested in watching it they forgot to do their work.
2026 update. 
I haven’t used this for a few years and am sooo disappointed. 1 countdown then ads for games that I couldn’t get out of. I was going to use it at church, totally inappropriate. Will give it one more try before deleting it.

reviews.title: Issue of Adds
reviews.text: I use this app for a student with a kindergartener with special needs who love the visualization of the timer. Unfortunately today we saw Temu underwear adds - horrified he clicked on it and was lead strait to a 5 year old inappropriate site. I might not be able to use this app in the future.

reviews.title: Get rid of ai art
reviews.text: Get rid of ai art. It’s gross.

reviews.title: Nonsense
reviews.text: Before the timer went off it gave me an ad. So the time didn’t even go off at the right time

reviews.title: Weird Ads
reviews.text: I’m a RBT and I’ve been using this timer for years. I accidentally clicked on an ad that popped up after the timer went off for my client. My phone was redirected to a scam ad insinuating I spent $569 on a porn website and my phone was locked due to detection of CSAM. This ad was disturbing and immediately made me delete the app. Very disappointed as my kiddos have loved the visuals and sounds of this timer.

reviews.title: inappropriate ads for kids
reviews.text: I use this app for work with kids in a kindergarten setting and the ads are ridiculously fast after the timer finishes and almost always inappropriate for their age. I had a 5 y/o student click on a reddit ad and another ad appeared to be some kind of sexualized ai app. I like that I can customize the timer and background and that’s about it.

reviews.title: Disturbing ads do not use
reviews.text: As a pediatric OT I relied on this app for most of my sessions however recently I used it and an ad for some sort of porn popped up while I was using it with a child! Absolutely disgusting and disturbing! Deleting this app immediately and posting about it in every OT group online I can think of so we can protect the children from being exposed to this kind of stuff. Absolutely inexcusable for that to have happened

reviews.title: Pornographic Content
reviews.text: This was great. But today I noticed 5 rated x images displayed in the ads bar across the bottom of the screen. This app is marked as safe for young children’s eyes. Parents and educators please delete!!!!!!!!!!!

reviews.title: Endless Timer
reviews.text: I am OT that works in pediatrics. Used to love this timer and used it daily. However, there is a new update that makes you manually stop the timer. If you’re unable to manually stop it the sound goes on and on and on and on and is annoying. It doesn’t even play the complete sound before it starts to loop through it again. Looking into other options for a different timer.

reviews.title: Porn advertisement!!
reviews.text: There was a porn add right on the timer screen! Not safe for use by anyone. Disgusting.

reviews.title: Pornographic adds
reviews.text: There were pornographic images in the ads, very visible while my kids were using the timer.

reviews.title: Inappropriate Add Pictures
reviews.text: Why?? Are there pictures of ladies in underwear on a timer for children?

reviews.title: Beware inappropriate ads!
reviews.text:
My child had a lot of fun with this app over the years, but the ads have gotten out of control. Not only are the ads ubiquitous and confusing for kids, I recently noticed an ad banner at the bottom that appeared to be some sort of pornography. I am really hopeful that my kid didn’t see that and get exposed, but I’m also furious that an app for kids would allow that sort of content all in the name of making a few extra bucks in ads.

I’ve removed this app from all my devices and I suggest everyone else does the same.

reviews.title: App works fine but has inappropriate ads
reviews.text: The app is okay but the advertisements at the bottom have women in bikinis and nearly naked women. Highly inappropriate for an app used for children. Do NOT use this.
